name: New Era
verdict: New Era (New Era Cap Co., LLC, Buffalo, NY) is a family-owned company, founded by Ehrhardt Koch in 1920 and led by fourth-generation CEO Christopher H. Koch. No state body or fund in the chain. Nothing found.
note: Official Cap of LIV Golf and all 13 teams (livgolf.com/partners); appears on every team page. The Koch family of Buffalo that owns New Era is unrelated to Koch, Inc. (koch-inc) of Wichita.
